== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The original may deploy on a Rebel Base system or Subjugated Planet and names your Imperial-class ships. Later it restricts deployment to a Rebel Base system, explicitly excludes Executor from the discount, and loses the Effect on opponent control. The later slip drops its old immunity to Rieekan. Haven cancellation, qualifying piloting and Alter immunity are retained.
